what: TONER-1 Pro printer fine-tune, run 2 (shipped), as saved in its checkpoint (cfg). The first chunk (iters 1 to 200) ran with --max_iters=900, which sets the cosine schedule; every later chunk used 750, the value below.
command: python -I -u training/scripts/pro_ft_train.py --out_dir=$TONER_TRAIN/ckpt/pro_ft/run_ft2_tag --lr=1e-4 --min_lr=5e-6 --warmup=50 --max_iters=750 --eval_interval=50 --max_wall_seconds=470 --replay_bos=2   (repeat until it reaches iter 750; it resumes from ckpt.pt)
